entities.summary:
Thekla, Latinized as Thecla, was the eldest child of Byzantine emperor Theophilos and empress Theodora, proclaimed augusta in the late 830s. As a prominent figure in the Amorian dynasty, she played a crucial role in the Byzantine Empire's politics during the late 8th and early 9th centuries. Thekla's association with the regime as co-empress alongside Theodora and Michael III was a significant development during this period.
